description: The count clauses of core's quest helper program (src/prolog/helper-predicates.ts, HELPER_PREDICATES_PROLOG): each objective_complete/3 clause that counts or totals facts, plus reputation/3's total, run in the shared engine to success at exactly its count and to failure one short of it, with a fact it must not count in the KB where the clause filters. Each case's kb opens with its dynamic declarations and the ONE clause under test, verbatim (comments dropped, whitespace collapsed). They count with findall/3 + length/2 and total with findall/3 + sum_list/2 because the shared engine has no library(aggregate): before PL.core-helper-aggregate-all every one of them called that library's counting predicate, raised existence_error and could never succeed. Two cases pin player_avg_pronunciation/2 alone, beside no other pack: the mean of one player's pronunciation_score/4 scores, and failure (not an error) with none; it called insimul_sum_list/2, which only the advanced pack defines, until PL.core-helper-sum-list. The last two cases pin convertQuestToProlog's quest_complete/2 rule for a defeat_enemies completion, which called the same missing predicate. Emitted by scripts/emit-quest-count-goals-corpus.ts (npm run quest-count-goals-corpus; :check fails when this file is stale).

cases.name: collect-any-reached
cases.description: collect('', 2) holds with exactly 2 counted fact(s), the decoy not counted
kb: objective_complete(Player, QuestId, Idx) :- quest_objective(QuestId, Idx, collect('', Count)), findall(x, collected(Player, _, _), Hits), length(Hits, Total), Total >= Count.

cases.description: observe_activity(2) holds with exactly 2 counted fact(s), the decoy not counted
kb: objective_complete(Player, QuestId, Idx) :- quest_objective(QuestId, Idx, observe_activity(Count)), findall(x, activity_observed(Player, _, _), Hits), length(Hits, Total), Total >= Count.

cases.name: observe-activity-one-short

kb: objective_complete(Player, QuestId, Idx) :- quest_objective(QuestId, Idx, observe_activity(Count)), findall(x, activity_observed(Player, _, _), Hits), length(Hits, Total), Total >= Count.

cases.name: reputation-total
cases.description: reputation/3 totals one faction's changes (4 - 1 = 3), another faction's not counted
kb: reputation(Player, Faction, Total) :- findall(D, reputation_change(Player, Faction, D), Terms), sum_list(Terms, Total).

cases.name: avg-pronunciation-mean
cases.description: player_avg_pronunciation/2, the clause alone (no advanced pack): the mean of the player's three scores (82 + 90 + 77) / 3 = 83, another player's score not counted
kb: player_avg_pronunciation(Player, Avg) :- findall(S, pronunciation_score(Player, _, S, _), Scores), Scores \= [], sum_list(Scores, Total), length(Scores, Count), Avg is Total / Count.

cases.name: avg-pronunciation-none
cases.description: player_avg_pronunciation/2, the clause alone: a player with no scores fails (no error, no 0), though another player has one
kb: player_avg_pronunciation(Player, Avg) :- findall(S, pronunciation_score(Player, _, S, _), Scores), Scores \= [], sum_list(Scores, Total), length(Scores, Count), Avg is Total / Count.

cases.name: converter-defeat-enemies-reached
cases.description: convertQuestToProlog's quest_complete/2 for completionCriteria defeat_enemies (wolf, 2): two wolves, a bear not counted
kb: quest_complete(Player, wolves_at_the_fold) :- findall(x, defeated(Player, wolf), Defeats), length(Defeats, C), C >= 2.

cases.name: converter-defeat-enemies-one-short

kb: quest_complete(Player, wolves_at_the_fold) :- findall(x, defeated(Player, wolf), Defeats), length(Defeats, C), C >= 2.
